status_vocabulary.Supported: An official or native mechanism exists and the Harness behavior is verified.
status_vocabulary.Mechanism verified: Harness package, adapter, or installer checks pass, but a real host run is not confirmed.
status_vocabulary.Live verified: A real host session or portal operation produced preserved evidence.
status_vocabulary.Partial: Only part of the capability is available or verified.
status_vocabulary.Unsupported: The host explicitly does not provide the required mechanism.
status_vocabulary.Unknown: The capability was not verified or the official documentation does not establish it.

claude-code.notes: By default a matched command returns no permission decision, so the session's permission mode, rules and auto-mode classifier decide. The hooks reference documents that a hook ask forces a prompt even in auto mode (#107). Deterministic tests verify the deferred result for every permission_mode value and the ask JSON of the opt-in HARNESS_ACTION_GATE_POLICY=always-ask. Live evidence (2026-09-15, plugin 0.3.8-beta, auto mode) showed the earlier forced ask prompting the user; the deferred behavior has no preserved live evidence yet.

codex.notes: Current Codex PreToolUse parses permissionDecision=ask but does not support it; Codex reports the hook failure and continues the tool call. Harness therefore uses exit 2 for matched destructive actions rather than relying on ask semantics.

hooksLifecycle.notes: Codex documents plugin-bundled hooks for manually installed desktop plugins, and the local package is mechanism-tested. The plugin intentionally does not declare unsupported PostToolUseFailure; Codex uses documented PostToolUse semantics instead. Harness also provides a user-config compatibility installer that copies the packaged runtime and merges exact-owned entries into $CODEX_HOME/hooks.json without changing trust/config.toml; successful plugin sync refreshes this copy. Live evidence verifies the UserPromptSubmit and Stop observation handlers through the compatibility fallback on one Windows Codex CLI 0.162.1 host; native plugin-bundled hook mounting and other lifecycle events remain unverified.

installUninstallSymmetry.notes: General Harness installer ownership is mechanism-tested. The optional codex-hooks compatibility fallback separately has exact-entry update/uninstall ownership tests and preserves unrelated user hooks. Live evidence confirms trusted dispatch for the two observation handlers on one Windows Codex CLI host; native plugin mounting and other scopes remain unverified.

updateSync.notes: scripts/plugin-sync.js detects installed state and uses marketplace upgrade for an installed Codex plugin; after successful install/update verification it refreshes the local codex-hooks compatibility runtime and hooks.json entries, retaining current plus previous distinct runtime. Tracked linked-worktree sources or dirty plugin subtrees require explicit unreleased-source opt-in; untracked packaged sources remain supported even inside unrelated dirty repositories. Unsupported CLI options are dropped and retried, and a Codex build without codex plugin list/add is reported as an actionable capability-boundary skip. Live marketplace source reporting and plugin-sync refresh remain unverified; the separate compatibility fallback dispatch is live-verified as recorded in the evidence artifact.

Native plugin mounting, marketplace source reporting, other lifecycle events, and other host/version combinations remain unverified.

pluginSupport.notes: OpenCode V2 plugin API only; OpenCode 1.x / V1 is unsupported (#453). Default export ({ id, setup(ctx) }) is the only public surface. Tested V2 live observations: OpenCode 2.1.4 (macOS 26.6.2, isolated V2 lifecycle trace at benchmarks/results/live-host/opencode-2026-11-24-v2-lifecycle/README.md establishing V2 default-export load, tool hooks, event envelope + session.execution.succeeded, and completion -> verification -> reminder delivery on a long-lived server), OpenCode 2.1.3 (macOS, server-log load-only), and OpenCode 2.1.4 (macOS, limited session workspace trace); no validated minimum patch version is claimed. Install under a .js filename because .mjs install names are silently ignored (issue #127). Retained OpenCode 1.18.31 (macOS) evidence (benchmarks/results/live-host/opencode-2026-09-16/README.md) is historical/unsupported V1 evidence only. Global scope, npm-package installation, and other host versions remain unverified.

hooksLifecycle.notes: OpenCode V2 plugin API only (OpenCode 1.x / V1 unsupported). An isolated OpenCode 2.1.4 (macOS 26.6.2) V2 lifecycle trace (benchmarks/results/live-host/opencode-2026-11-24-v2-lifecycle/README.md) establishes V2 default-export load, V2 tool hooks (tool.execute.before/after), the V2 event envelope + session.execution.succeeded completion, and completion -> verification -> reminder delivery on a long-lived server (standalone opencode run exits before verification finishes). Router/context injection, observation recording, ledger lessons, session create/delete reset, and cancellation were not exercised live and remain mechanism-verified only; OpenCode 2.1.3 evidence is load-only and the 2026-11-15 OpenCode 2.1.4 workspace trace did not fire V2 hooks. Retained historical/unsupported V1 evidence (benchmarks/results/live-host/opencode-2026-09-16/README.md) covers project-scope .js loading and edit/verification state on OpenCode 1.18.31 (macOS) from a post-reset snapshot predating Rule-of-3 retirement (hard lock was only an interactive observation with no retained blocked-tool trace; reflection was operator-seeded) and does not establish current V2 capability. Global scope, npm-package installation, and other host versions remain unverified.

projectScope.notes: Project-scope V2 default-export load, tool hooks, session.execution.succeeded completion, and completion -> verification -> reminder delivery on a long-lived server were observed on one OpenCode 2.1.4 (macOS 26.6.2) run (benchmarks/results/live-host/opencode-2026-11-24-v2-lifecycle/README.md), alongside OpenCode 2.1.3 (macOS) server-log load and 2.1.4 (macOS) workspace field availability; router/context injection, observations, ledger lessons, session create/delete reset, and cancellation remain unverified live. Standalone skill discovery remains path-contract verified. Retained OpenCode 1.18.31 (macOS) artifact is historical/unsupported V1 evidence only.

hooksLifecycle.notes: Deterministic mechanism tests cover SessionStart, PreInvocation, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and Stop.
